title: Newly completed Showdown is archived but the same Legacy visit renders stale history
steps: Have two completed Showdowns already in Legacy history.
Finish a third Showdown normally, for example Nik 11 to Daniel 9, so the active Showdown status is Completed.

Open Legacy. archiveCompletedSaveBeforeLegacy first calls loadLegacyShowdowns, which caches the two-record history, then archiveShowdown writes the third record through the Save Library raw transaction.
The same render then calls loadLegacyShowdowns again and receives the unchanged two-record cache, so SHOWDOWNS PLAYED and the card list still show 2 instead of 3.
Reloading or otherwise invalidating the Legacy cache lets the saved third record appear.
expected: The first Legacy render after completion should show 3 completed Showdowns, including the new 11 to 9 result, immediately after the archive succeeds.
actual: The archive transaction saves the third record, but the same Legacy render can keep showing the previous two-record cached history until cache invalidation or reload.
root_cause: runtimeArchiveShowdown writes legacyShowdowns through applyCareerModeRawStorageTransaction but does not invalidate legacyCache or increment legacyStorageRevision. archiveCompletedSaveBeforeLegacy has already populated that cache before the write. The later render therefore reads stale cached history.
checked_against: js/saveLibraryRuntime.js runtimeArchiveShowdown replaces an existing record by showdown id, so repeated archive attempts do not create a duplicate.
js/storage.js saveLegacyShowdowns correctly refreshes legacyCache and increments legacyStorageRevision, but runtimeArchiveShowdown bypasses that helper.
js/storage.js invalidateLegacyCache exists and is used for other Legacy storage changes, but is not called after the Save Library archive transaction.

fix.change: After a successful runtimeArchiveShowdown Legacy write, invalidate or refresh the same-tab Legacy cache and revision through a small public storage hook. Keep the existing raw transaction and ID replacement logic unchanged.

assumptions: Normal local play uses Save Library runtime authority before the completed Showdown is opened in Legacy.
A successful archive should be visible on the same Legacy visit without requiring a page reload.
